parsed.name: VDI PM5B功率计
parsed.description: 用于与 VDI PM5B 功率计通信，获取功率读数，并解析量程、状态与固件版本信息，适合实验中的射频或微波功率测量。
parsed.description_en: Communicates with the VDI PM5B power meter to obtain power readings and parse range, status, and firmware version information for RF or microwave power measurements in laboratory experiments.

actions.description: 格式化发送给功率计的命令字符串，添加所需的填充与终止符。
actions.description_en: Format a command string for the power meter by adding the required padding and termination characters.

actions.description: 根据所选量程和计数值换算功率读数，并按校准因子进行修正。
actions.description_en: Convert a raw count value into a power reading based on the selected range, with calibration-factor correction.

actions.description: 解析 D 类型数据包，提取功率读数与状态信息，并可换算为 dBm。
actions.description_en: Decode a D packet to extract the power reading and status information, including conversion to dBm.

actions.description: 解析 VC 类型数据包，读取主固件和次固件版本信息。
actions.description_en: Decode a VC packet to read the primary and secondary firmware version information.

actions.description: 向功率计发送查询命令并返回设备响应。
actions.description_en: Send a query command to the power meter and return the device response.
